payload.abstract: This observational study evaluated the effects of type 2 diabetes on cerebral vasoregulation and functional outcomes, measured by blood flow responses to hypocapnia and hypercapnia, Valsalva maneuver, head-up tilt, and sit-to-stand test. This dataset contains 37 diabetic participants and 49 controls (aged  55 to 75 years) with continuous measurements of cerebral blood flow using transcranial Doppler and MRI, heart rate, blood pressure, and respiratory parameters, balance, walking, laboratory and retinopathy measures.

payload.short_description: Diabetes is a risk factor for cerebral hypoperfustion and microvascular disease. This study assessed the effects of diabetic autonomic neuropathy with OH on cerebral vasoregulation.
payload.title: Cerebral Vasoregulation in Diabetes
